caption.body:
7 export support schemes every exporter should know by name.

Government export schemes can change often, so the smartest first step is to know what exists and where the official rules are published. Advance Authorisation, EPCG and RoDTEP sit with DGFT and the Department of Commerce. Duty Drawback is handled through Customs. The Market Access Initiative, Niryat Bandhu and ZED Certification support market entry, training and quality.

Before you apply for any scheme, read the current official guidelines and ask your customs broker or consultant whether it fits your product.
